name: ISIC 2019 Grand Challenge
description: A grand challenge validating AI models for skin cancer diagnosis using a large dermoscopy image dataset and standardized evaluation protocols.
reputation: Widely used and well-regarded in the medical imaging community with an established challenge history and broad participation.
notes: Medical imaging benchmark — non-LLM. Common caveats include class imbalance, domain shift between imaging centers, and potential dataset contamination; careful external validation is recommended.
